prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: Children and adults safely playing at a shallow summer beach with sand and umbrellas. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "The Beach". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Summer beach, sand and sea.
Ice and water, feel very well.
Swim with care, stay near the land.
Hold the hand and understand.
Deep sea, danger, keep away.
Safe and cool, love the day.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
